# mockingbird_channel (Resource)

The settings of one event channel (Kafka, AMQP, MQTT or WebSocket) of a mock's active contract: whether it runs and when the mock publishes on it. Destroying it re-enables the channel with the contract's triggers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Publish a generated order event every 30 seconds instead of on demand.
resource "mockingbird_channel" "order_created" {
  mock     = mockingbird_mock.orders_events.name
  channel  = "orderCreated"
  enabled  = true
  triggers = jsonencode([{ schedule = { every_ms = 30000 } }])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel` (String) Channel id in the active contract.
- `mock` (String) Name of the mock.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the channel runs. Default `true`.
- `triggers` (String) JSON array of MCM triggers replacing the contract's, e.g. `jsonencode([{ schedule = { every_ms = 5000 } }])`, `jsonencode(["manual"])` or `jsonencode([{ cron = { expr = "*/5 * * * *" } }])`. Unset uses the contract's. Only channels the mock publishes may have triggers.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace of the resource. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Topic, routing key, queue or WebSocket path.
- `direction` (String) `publish` (the mock produces) or `subscribe` (the mock consumes).
- `effective_triggers` (String) The triggers in effect, as a JSON array.
- `id` (String) Identifier, `<workspace>/<mock>/<channel>`; also the import ID.
- `protocol` (String) `kafka`, `amqp`, `mqtt` or `websocket`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A channel is imported as <workspace>/<mock>/<channel>.
terraform import mockingbird_channel.order_created default/orders-events/orderCreated
```
